notes.title: WINTER SALE! Discounts for YOU!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/83839842a854b3e89ecb06c25d02394ee3f69403.png


Feel free to change your wallpaper to something interesting. This is the best time to download my unique designs at such a low price.


Hello everyone and we wish you a Happy Holidays and an awesome 2024.

My name is Greg and I am the founder of 3DM whose goal was to design and release unique designs as wallpapers on the Steam platform...and we did it. :D

3DM is not a company with offices and a team. 3DM has never had external financial support. I created 3DM as a single person who used my own funds to employ freelancers who coded my crazy ideas for you. I thank them very much for their support.

Despite everything, we managed to publish 14 projects that appeared on many screens around the world. Countless problems, sleepless nights, sweat and tears. Over time, we got better and the designs were improved thanks to the support of players. Thanks to your support. Thank you with all my heart.

As a thank you and on the occasion of the Winter Steam Sale, we are publishing big discounts for those who have just discovered my designs. I highly encourage you to try it and to support the micro developer.

I wish you a lot of health and joy with your loved ones.

I wish 2024 to be better for everyone!

Big love and thanks for support. 

Best wishes,
Greg 3DM

notes.title: FULL RELEASE - MY WOLF
notes.content:
Hello,

I am pleased to announce that our great project MY WOLF is leaving Early Access.

MY WOLF is our long journey as the project itself has been completely changed. After a month of work, we managed to release a stable version as Early Access, where it was not without problems that we had to quickly fix and improve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/e56f54159c8f6a674fa7d7a6840d4635f522dd94.jpg

It turned out that you like such an unusual project, so we started building new components. MY WOLF got a lot of fixes and new content thanks to your support in the comments. It is thanks to you that this project is better. Thank you.

Code improvements, bug fixes, translation improvements, performance, improved AI, day and night system and a lot more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/5253e67437958150b7056eb6424878e01a87050c.jpg

Not everything was added. Or we changed our minds. :?
The wolf was supposed to have offspring but after numerous trials and (ethical) problems we decided not to continue this stage.

Unfortunately, we also did not manage to remove the inscription Early Access from the game, not knowing if we would add anything else, and unfortunately, we temporarily lost access to the project. As soon as we get it back, we'll add a fix.

Once again, thank you very much for your support. Now MY WOLF is a truly unique project.

Best Regards,
3DM Team

notes.title: Sound and Music
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/2f6375e8765335695a42caf0249ed8406009ef7f.jpg

Hey.

According to the Early Access schedule, we added sounds and music which should significantly improve the experience.

Unfortunately, it is not easy to get the sounds of a wolf, but we managed to mix what was a bit. It would be too dangerous to look for and record real wolves. We also don't have a forest nearby.

We also added the option to turn off sounds and music, leaving only the sound of a wolf howling when it wants us. Thanks to this you can listen to your own music and still know what is happening with the wolf.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/6c8620ce09e993e2a9f4847a621feb32046192c0.jpg

I hope you will like the music too. We aimed at delicate forest sounds that will not be intrusive.

Let me know what you think about it. Maybe something needs to be added or changed?

Have a nice experience. :D 

3DM

notes.title: MY WOLF Update 3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/8a760c1ea9d785268abfe4b55ec66981bb50b447.jpg

Hello Everybody :D

We come with another package of fixes and improvements.

The most important change is the new ability to send a wolf to a selected point on the map. Thanks to this, you can tell him where to go if you notice an interesting place. The wolf will obey your command if his confidence level (heart) is greater than 25%.

In order to show the way for the wolf, you have to hover the mouse over it and select a new (violet) icon, then select a point on the map and click the left mouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/eb65ae9c9069c5a62cc570abbc94236b1676780c.jpg

Additional fixes / changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/0ddd11f935fab6056f24dda03bbf330d043623c1.jpg

Camera Offset - now you can move the camera so the wolf is not always centred in the centre. Very useful when you have two screens and a frame in the middle. Now you move the wolf to the right or left screen.

Glare effect - updated glare effect to enhance your game.

Balance - we have improved the balance of sleep, food and love.

Updated Anti-stuck system - the wolf should no longer get stuck in place.

Additionally, available in a few days - we are still testing these options.

Indicators - we have added indicators that show on the wolf when we can do something. The pointers also appear above the rabbits, which we can knock over with a quick mouse movement.

Rejecting the ball - when the wolf brings us the ball, we can reject it immediately without entering the menu.

We probably added something else but as usual, I don't remember but our dev won't be angry because he doesn't even read it. btw. Someone is reading this? ;D

Music and sounds will be released soon. We already have 85% done. Unfortunately, it's hard to get wolf sounds and it's too far for me to the forest. Do I have wolves in the area? ;D

Thanks again for the suggestions. If you notice any problems, please write to me and we will correct it.

I wish you a nice day and night.
3DM

notes.title: Road Map
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/5ff2f1d7a669f58248c3ae6363d9dbb91212189a.jpg

Hello everybody,

We would like to share our plans for MY WOLF. The game is currently in Early Access and we are still working on it. We have a lot of plans that will appear in future patches.

List below. The order is random so any of these points may appear soon.

Sounds and music.
Sounds and music will be added. It will be possible to turn them off but leaving the howling of the wolf that will call us.

Better menus and UI.
The menu will be corrected. A manual will be added with a description of all functions.

Better language translations.
We will minimize the number of mistakes in translations.

Wolf Character.
We will adjust the values ​​on which the wolf is built. Aspects such as hunger, sleepiness, hunting intensity etc. will be improved.

Wolf navigation.
We will be able to designate a place where the wolf can go. He can be directed to the rabbits when the wolf is hungry.

Complete life cycle.
We start with a little wolf that grows, and when it is big, we will meet a partner with whom we will have a small wolf that will be under our care in the future.

Game system.
We will improve and add aspects of the game. Many of these ideas come from our supporters. Thank you.

I remind that the order is random.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/485e657c6caa4e7af725504bbe66159407f6e5be.jpg

This is probably not the complete list, and many ideas could come up. If you have ideas to improve MY WOLF, please describe them in the comments.

Thank you very much for your support.
3DM

notes.title: MY WOLF Update 2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/1e421c06e8faf445f3098c933036047b98fab402.jpg

Hello Everyone :D

We are still working on MY WOLF to improve gameplay and add new features.

Thank you very much for the reported errors. For example, thanks to the photos sent in, we were able to quickly determine where the wolf was stuck.


We have added a system that recognizes the blockage of the wolf to release it quickly. When your wolf gets stuck in one place, the game will help him get out.


Here is a list of other fixes:

-Fixed wolf collapse at the bridge

- You will see a confirmation screen when changing the screen settings. Useful for people with multiple screens.

-The wolf will no longer sit in the water

-EarlyAccess moved to the menu

- Removed sound items from the menu. The sounds will be added soon.

-Move menu, added to tray menu. To move the menu when it falls off the screen. Useful for people with multiple screens.

-Improved Wolf Happiness Level Bar (Heart Belt)

Probably something more...

Many of these fixes have been made possible by you. Thank you for the information thanks to which we could improve our game.

We've probably already fixed most of the bugs that made it difficult to play, so now we're focusing on adding more content to complete this project.

MYWOLF is over in EARLY ACCESS but we are striving to release the full version.

Thank you once again and we wish you all the best.

3DM

notes.title: MY WOLF Released in Early Access!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/8db3bde83cf115c2814b1775980a7266d1df88bc.jpg

Hello,

Finally, after an over a year of development, many problems and changes, MY WOLF arrived on Steam in Early Access.

MY WOLF probably is the first virtual pet game displayed as interactive wallpaper on Windows10. (It's for Windows10 only).

It's a relaxing game where you take care of little wolf that will grow up on your screen. Really, he will be bigger and bigger.

The full description is on the store page.

MY WOLF is in Early Access! so not everything is done. Please keep this in mind doing reviews.

The project will be updated every few days so it can be only better and better.

Soon I gonna add ROAD MAP to show you what we plan to add but always you can text me with your ideas. Same if you notice any bugs. I will answer as soon as possible.

Please let me know with any problems, I'm here to solve any issue.

btw. we have a Facebook, Twitter, YouTube channel....join to be on time with all news.

Best Regards,
3DM

notes.title: Join Beta Tests
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35340247/5b85b058083e19876dfcae2ae562ee3b7b93fb26.jpg

Hello Everyone :D

Finally, after a year of development, the MY WOLF is almost ready.

The project has been completely changed so It took more time than we expected.

We need your help to test it before and after Early Access release. We are open to suggestions but for now, we concentrate on bugs fix. After Early Access release, there will be more content for sure.


How to join our Beta Testers team:

- Invite me to a friends.
- Text me...."Hello 3DM, I want to try MY WOLF" or something like that ;d
- You have Windows 10! (required)
- Join our 3DM group on Steam (not required)

Make sure you really want it, you have time and you can text us any problems or ideas. 

The amount of new testers is limited. Please, make sure you really want to help.

Each new Beta Tester will get a free key to MY WOLF. You will be able to play MY WOLF before the release.

Please remember that MY WOLF will be released as Early Access and not everything is done.


What we are looking for? 
Any bugs, unexpected behaviours, Wolf stuck places, translations update, new ideas.

The tutorials from the menu are not ready yet. Will be added soon.

Do you want to try and help us? Text me ;D


Peace!

3DM

notes.title: The 1st Announcement.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35340247/1f788c680428e733947de15dc5bf9289e81437f4.jpg

Hello Everybody :D

We are starting a new series depicting the life of wild animals. MY WOLF is an interactive project in which we look after a small wolf controlled by advanced AI. Most of the time the wolf is independent, however (especially at the beginning) when the wolf is still small it will require our help. We will tell him and teach him new behaviours so that he can cope in an open world.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35340247/4258eb8c8c1cb6d903cc8559027aa6ec68bab0d4.jpg

This project is much more complicated than our previous wallpapers so we will start from Early Access to refine everything. We encourage everyone to familiarize themselves with the project and suggest what can be added or improved.

We will post here more and more information about this project because work on it is going very smoothly: D We encourage you to follow this wallpaper by adding to your WISHLIST.

More information soon! (also on our Facebook / Twitter).

Thanks for every support :D

3DM
